rationale: Single ATM-network announcement page on otpbanka.si; covered by monitoring the bank's press/news parent.
One-off T&C PDF from a single savings bank — useful as dated evidence of scheme/processor change, not a recurring feed.
Statutory Banka Slovenije e-money issuer register; failed URL is a soft signal, register itself is durable and in-scope.
Central-bank hub for non-bank PSP and FMI supervision — durable index of payment-market buyers.
EEA passporting list sits under the bsi.si supervised-entities parent already being monitored.
Adjacent credit-servicer/intermediary registers on bsi.si; marginal for A2 tenders but captured via parent.
ZBS member list enumerates the Slovenian bank buyer universe — mine once for the actor map, then archive.
ZBS committee/working-body page names payments and IT owners; one-off harvest, rarely changes.
Bancni vestnik archive publishes continuously and signals bank modernisation projects ahead of tenders.
National Payments Council publishes recurring minutes naming initiatives that become procurement.
GZS ZIT membership enumerates the domestic ICT supplier/bidder pool — one-off mine.
GZS chamber index used once to enumerate finance- and ICT-adjacent associations; homepage itself is not a signal feed.
Digital coalition working-group list is a broad, weakly payments-specific actor index; failed URL — recheck before mining.
Blockchain Alliance membership overlaps crypto-payments vendor pool; modest credibility, mine once.
Second blockchain association, largely redundant with c_267 and low credibility for A2 tenders.
OPSI open-data list of all ZJN-3 contracting authorities — the definitive buyer register for the A2 workstream.
ATVP statutory registers extend the financial-actor universe but are securities-side and URL failed; recheck liveness.
EBA PSD2 central register, bulk-downloadable and filterable to SI; durable cross-check on national lists.
